title: Compact tractor
description: Friendly bright-blue compact farm tractor: a chunky hood with a white grille surround, side headlights and an exhaust stack, big lugged yellow-rimmed rear wheels under arched mudguards and small front wheels, an open roll frame with a white canopy roof over the seat, steps up to the footplate, a drawbar hitch at the back, a driver in a cap, and a front-mounted mower deck (node `deck`, exactly 1 m wide, scaled in x to 2.5..6 m) on two arms ahead of the front tyres. Material `paint` is repainted per player.
checks: LEFT tile: small front wheels and big rear wheels all touching the grid line, hood at the front end, the deck low ahead of the front tyre with a gap
LEFT tile: the mudguard arcs over the rear tyre with a visible gap all round; no tyre passes through a mudguard, step, floor or deck
3/4 tile: a driver in a cap sits on the seat under the canopy, hands on the steering wheel, boots on the floor
3/4 tile: reads as a friendly blue farm tractor (not a mower or a car): chunky hood, exhaust stack, roll frame with a canopy
BACK tile: the drawbar and hitch pin low in the middle, both rear tyres clear of the mudguards, the canopy above
TOP tile: the canopy covers the seat; the two deck arms reach from under the hood to the deck's back edge
